ns2:section.sectionText: Intensive course on field diagnostic skills in weed science. Topics include weed and weed seed identification, sprayer calibration, herbicide application, herbicide injury symptomatology, and field diagnostics. Students who complete the course will be encouraged to enter the North Central Weed Science Society weeds contest, which occurs during the summer. Course Information: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CPSC 212 or CPSC 426 or consent of instructor.
